name: Sparks (metal hit)
description: A ricochet or metal strike: a short burst of bright sparks that fades in a few frames.

looks.text: A close view of metal sparks: spark streak detail only.

prompt.subject: a burst of sparks at {where}
prompt.timing: a burst of bright sparks flies from {where} at {burst}, fading by {fade} and gone by {clear}
prompt.action: At {burst} something strikes {where}: a short burst of bright orange sparks flies outward at full real-time speed with no slow motion, the sparks arc and die out within a few frames.
